d: Who will become the next Prime Minister of Israel? Incumbent Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has failed to secure a majority with many of the parties putting their weight behind challenger Gadi Eisenkot. Arab parties have pledged to support Gadi Eisenkot if he does not carry out similar military actions the way Netanyahu did. Gadi Eisenkot is a former IDF Chief, who was selected to that post when Netanyhu was Israel's PM.
